scope: One completed proxy-free 100-target full Firecrawl v2 API run after native identifier search. Normalized HTML matches are reported separately from literal Markdown marker matches.

metricDefinitions.normalizedHtml: Successful HTTP/API response with the frozen expected text after markup/script/style/noscript removal and without a detected challenge/page error. Title text is retained; CSS visibility and full-page correctness are not established.
metricDefinitions.normalizedAndMarkdown: Normalized HTML pass and the supplementary frozen literal phrase present in Markdown. A changed heading can miss this phrase even when useful product content is returned.

pacing.limit: Slot reservation precedes fetch. Observed gaps are retained; configuration is not an exact dispatch floor.

lowesObservation.observedPath: WebKit returned HTTP 403 with a closed receipt, then Firefox used the homepage and native GET search, received HTTP 301 and reached the requested product with HTTP 200. URL-derived identifier only; no expected phrase is supplied.
lowesObservation.limit: The current product heading is shorter than the frozen historical phrase. The exact phrase matches HTML title text, not the current visible heading or Markdown. No title text was injected into Markdown and no grader was changed.

browserCI.scope: Current-source browser CI jobs. Does not assert that unrelated Blacksmith workflows completed, nor that hosted parity is achieved.

verification.contextCloseLimit: Target's Firefox Page closed, but context cleanup was still unconfirmed when the bounded cleanup returned after 1502 ms. Eventual context-close timing is not proven by that response; final zero active Pages/sessions and owner removal do not replace that receipt.

primary-a.limit: Cgroup measurements include the persistent collector and cannot prove absence of shared host contention.

fallback-a.limit: Cgroup measurements include the persistent collector and cannot prove absence of shared host contention.

cleanup.limit: Task-scoped ownership and current state are verified. The earlier development inventory is not relabeled as a full-run-start snapshot; no whole-machine preservation claim is made.

shutdownLimit: The harness reported all processes terminated and exited 0, but the existing extract-worker Channel-closing teardown error remains. This is not a clean-shutdown claim.

historicalHostedComparison.limit: Different epoch and provider routing/retry policies. Hosted parity remains unproven.

nextEvidence: Investigate the unconfirmed Target context-close acknowledgement with an owned delayed-close fixture before changing cleanup admission or claiming every context closes within the response bound. Continue coverage work only from a supported proxy-free navigation or runtime hypothesis.
